d:
In this conversation with The Hindu, weather bloggers-Pradeep John, Tamil Nadu Weatherman and K.Srikanth of Chennaiyil Oru Mazhaikalam- discuss TN's favourite season-Northeast monsoon, possibility of extreme weather events and their forecasting methods.
They also talk about challenges of communicating weather information, handling prediction misses and online trolling. In a lighter segment, journalists from The Hindu Reporting team put them through some fun questions.
Thank you for watching our video!
